description: One confirmed fix/decision (idempotency key for double charges) plus unrelated review findings nobody acted on.

record.prompt: customers got charged twice when they double-clicked pay. fix it. also, while you're there, look over the payments module
record.assistant:
Fixed the double charge. Root cause: the Pay button posts twice on a double-click, and each request created a new charge. Rather than only disabling the button in the UI (which wouldn't cover retries after a network timeout), I persist an idempotency key on the order and pass it to the gateway, which deduplicates charges with the same key for 24h. A repeated request now returns the original charge.

While reviewing the module I also noticed, but did not change:
- refunds don't check that the refund amount <= captured amount
- gateway errors are logged with the full card BIN
- the webhook handler doesn't verify the signature
Tell me if you want those handled.

must_capture.fact: fixed with idempotency key persisted on order
